chunks: The takbir came to be in Mina after fifteen prayers, and in the towns after ten prayers, because when the people depart in the first departure, the people of the towns stop the takbir, while the people of Mina continue saying takbir as long as they remain in Mina until the final departure.

key_terms.التَّكْبِيرُ: The saying of Allahu Akbar in this ritual context after prayers.
key_terms.النَّفْرِ الْأَوَّلِ: The first departure from Mina during the days of Tashriq.
key_terms.الْأَمْصَارِ: The towns or settled regions outside Mina.
key_terms.دُبُرِ: Immediately after or at the end of the prayer.
key_terms.مِنًى: Mina, where pilgrims remain during the days of Hajj and continue the takbir longer.

ai.seo_question: Why is takbir recited after fifteen prayers in Mina but after ten prayers in other towns during Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the reason for the differing number of post-prayer takbirs in Mina and in other towns during the days of Hajj. Those outside Mina stop at the first departure, while the pilgrims remaining in Mina continue until the final departure, establishing the legal distinction in practice.
